title: For Chinese Equities, The Good News Is In Short Supply
gist: Chinese equities fell sharply in October (CSI 300 -8.5%) and are down 14% YTD, with fortunes tied to the US AI data center buildout amid weak domestic demand. Shrinking supply of newly tradeable stocks in 2027 offers a favorable base if sentiment recovers. Only a teaser of the article is available.

insights.claim: China's benchmark CSI 300 fell 8.5% in October 2026, its worst month in more than a decade, leaving the onshore market down 14% for the year.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Chinese equities are in a deep drawdown despite official support.
insights.quote: the benchmark CSI 300 fell 8.5% in October, its worst month in more than a decade

insights.claim: Market regulators, the People's Bank of China and the National Team all intervened after the October rout, yet the market remains down 14% year to date.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Official backstops have limited the damage but not restored sentiment.

themes.theme: AI Dependence and Weak Domestic Demand

insights.claim: China's equity fortunes are tied squarely to global sentiment on the AI boom, especially the pace of the US data center buildout.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: A wobble in US AI capex expectations transmits directly to Chinese stocks.
insights.quote: market fortunes are tied squarely to global sentiment on the artificial-intelligence boom

insights.claim: The reliance on a single AI story is especially intense because domestic demand has shown no significant improvement and policymakers continue to struggle to boost sustainable demand.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Without a domestic demand offset, the market lacks an alternative driver.
insights.locator: This reliance on a single story

insights.claim: The supply of newly tradeable stocks hitting the market should keep shrinking in 2027 to the lowest level in a decade.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Reduced share supply is a technical tailwind for Chinese equities.
insights.locator: the supply of newly tradeable stocks

insights.claim: Falling supply of tradeable stocks creates a favorable foundation for Chinese equities should sentiment rebound.
insights.speaker: Gavekal Research
insights.so_what: Upside could be amplified when sentiment turns, as supply will not absorb the demand.
insights.quote: That creates a favorable foundation should sentiment rebound.
